# Write Guard canary — DO NOT EDIT OR DELETE

This file was created and is tracked by Write Guard (RVG), a tool on
this PC that watches for files silently reverting. Nothing should ever
legitimately write to this file after its creation. If Write Guard
ever logs a change to it, that's strong evidence something outside the
normal CHANGE_LOG/BACKLOG write path is active in this folder.
